entries.cd3084c9e047de03: A single segment that plans and sells socks, pantyhose and tights. It consists of the company, 4 consolidated subsidiaries (Tabio Nara Co., Ltd., Tabio France S.A.S., Tabio Retail S.A.S. and Tabiou Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.) and 1 non-consolidated subsidiary (Tabio Factory Co., Ltd.). Tabio Nara Co., Ltd. handles logistics from product storage through shipment, as well as product research, inspection and quality control. As of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 266 in total, consisting of 154 directly operated stores and 112 franchise chain stores. Revenue in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥16,812 million.
